claims.claim: Committed only the new TASK-156 certification module and two authorized roadmap documents; production code and execution substrate remain unchanged.
The live route performs one discovery, two planned same-URL acquisitions through one manager/tool/sink, confined persistence, and one finally-bound cleanup without recovery behavior.
The certification composes exact TASK-138 intake, TASK-139 planning, TASK-140 disposable family admission, and two ordered TASK-141 singleton variant admissions.
Persistent grounded QA is invoked once from the temporary SQLite catalog and exact intake manifests using a deterministic single-call zero-network provider.
Live failures use bounded sanitized pytrace-disabled categories, and the module contains deterministic offline helper and source-level tests for its test-only surfaces.
Both roadmaps record TASK-154/P6.0a as published and closed, TASK-155 as execution-substrate-only, TASK-156 as the conditional P6.0b/P6.0 closure gate, and P6.1 as subsequent to that gate.
